title: unified-rollouts: enhanced canary + shadow AB auto-rollback with metric matching and observability
author: Claire Huang
description:
Motivation: improve safety and observability for progressive rollouts (canary, A/B and shadow traffic) and enable automated rollback decisions based on multi-metric matching and user-configurable thresholds. This change combines: 1) enhanced metric matching to reduce false positives when comparing shadow traffic to production; 2) staged canary weighting and automated rollback windows; 3) richer observability (per-route histograms, per-model error breakdowns) and alerts; 4) end-to-end tests and stability guards to avoid flapping.

Summary of changes (high level):
- rollout/controller: new AutoRollbackPolicy implementation that supports multi-metric matching (latency P95, error-rate, model-quality delta) and configurable similarity windows.
- rollout/scheduler: staged weighting scheduler that performs gradual increases with safety checks and a hard rollback trigger.
- observability: added per-route/model breakdown metrics (rollout.request_latency_ms.p95, rollout.request_error_rate, rollout.quality_delta.avg) and labels for shadow/canary/primary.
- api: extended rollout CRD (JSON schema) to allow users to declare canary + shadow strategies, metric matching rules, and stability windows. Backwards compatible - defaults preserve previous behavior.
- tests: unit tests for matching logic + integration E2E harness (docker-compose) exercising canary -> rollback path.
- docs: rollout strategy doc updates and migration guide for existing rollouts.

Checklist:
- [x] Implementation of matching algorithm
- [x] Unit tests for matcher and scheduler
- [x] Integration E2E tests for automated rollback path
- [x] Metrics and dashboards (temporary debug dashboards added to staging)
- [x] Migration notes and release notes

Notes/links: Linear ENG-2459 tracks algorithm design. SUP-1124 is a customer incident where a shadow comparison produced false positives; this PR implements mitigations. Design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-2459/autorollback-metric-matching-design (internal)

Compatibility: the rollout CRD was extended but fields are optional; existing rollouts will continue to use legacy matching unless opt-in to new policy.

Testing: local unit tests + CI integration tests run on PR. Staging rollout exercised behind a feature flag for 48 hours before merging.

review_conversation: Diego Ramirez: Overall looks good. Two asks: 1) make sure metric windows are configurable per-route; 2) add a small guard to avoid rollback storms when multiple rollouts flip at once.
Claire Huang (author): Thanks Diego - added per-route window config and a global cooldown that prevents repeated rollbacks within 10 minutes per-app. See staged_scheduler.go updates.
Priya Nair: The matcher logic looks sound but I want to see a benchmark for added CPU overhead on the controller for high-cardinality routes.
Claire Huang (author): Added a microbenchmark in tests/e2e/matcher_bench.go and tuned the matcher cache to reduce overhead. Bench shows <3% CPU increase for 1k qps of route churn.
Samir Patel: Observability additions are helpful. Request: tag metrics with model_version and route_id so we can correlate.
Claire Huang (author): Added model_version and route_id labels to rollout metrics; updated dashboards.
Diego Ramirez: Approving pending green CI and staging runs (approved).
Priya Nair: Approving after verifying benchmark logs in CI (approved).
ci_checks: ci/e2e: flaky - one test failed on first run, rerun passed
ci_notes: One intermittent e2e test failed on first run (timeout during docker network setup) and was retried automatically by CI; subsequent run passed. Benchmarks indicate matcher adds ~2.8% CPU under synthetic load and memory usage within expected bounds.
post_merge_actions: Enable rollout feature-flag 'autorollback-v2' in staging for 48h
Run migration script to annotate existing rollouts with legacy policy metadata
Schedule a follow-up to audit any rollbacks triggered in first 72h
release_notes: Added configurable AutoRollbackPolicy to unified rollouts: supports multi-metric matching (p95 latency, error-rate, quality delta), staged canary weighting with safety guards, and richer per-route observability. Opt-in via rollout.autoRollback config; defaults remain backwards compatible.
migration_notes: Existing rollouts are unaffected by default. To opt-in to the new matching behavior update your rollout manifest with 'autoRollback: {enabled: true, metrics: [...] }'. A migration helper is included in tools/migrations/annotate_rollouts.sh.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: false positives causing unnecessary rollbacks could impact availability. Mitigation: multi-metric matching, per-route similarity windows, global rollback cooldown, and staging rollout behind feature flag for 48h; dashboards and alerting added to detect flapping.
